freeze.reason: v2 adds focused normal-emitted malformed unprefixed QName ordering coverage; production codec is unchanged

findings.summary: The directive pass still expands every non-namespace attribute in source order before token accounting and application. The unprefixed marker is set only after successful expansion, preserving malformed and unbound-name refusal ordering.

Unprefixed attributes resolve to NO_NAMESPACE regardless of the element default namespace. Existing start-tag validation rejects prefixed bindings to the empty URI, so the marker cannot classify a prefixed name as unprefixed.
Inherited opaque starts return before directive scanning and receive no reuse markers; their filter=false writer path continues to expand and preserve malformed, MCE, and ordinary attributes.

Recognized MCE attributes are marked only after QName and local-name recognition, then counted and skipped once by active emitted starts. Inactive and opaque paths retain their report behavior, and ProcessContent validation remains in apply_directives and unwrap checks.
The candidate adds only infallible bit stores, retains existing fallible reservations and checked limits, and introduces no new allocation or typed-error path.

The focused layout test compares Attr with the former three-field representation on the current compiler target, and the source comment scopes the padding statement to that regression check rather than asserting a universal repr(Rust) guarantee.
The v2 test covers both prefixed and unprefixed malformed names, places each after a valid unprefixed attribute, and checks both malformed-first and unknown-directive-first source orders.
The active MCE marker condition is collapsed to !a.keep && filter, avoiding the prior nested-if collapsible_if warning while retaining the same invariant and report behavior.
The v2 freeze contains exactly codec.rs and tests.rs; the production codec identity is unchanged from v1 and the patch hash, byte count, base commit, and file hashes are bound above.
